prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Connector's test of a Sunday activity pattern behind the change from 405 to 228 displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" [F6] has no grounding in measurement timestamps, because Parking Servis publishes 621 values across 27 locations from 22 min ago without any measurement time [F5]. Observer's pairing with 230 values from 2 RHMZ automatic stations received 22 min ago [F28] likewise provides no alignment when the age of the parking data is unknown [F5], while SEPA reported 67 min ago with 1213 values across 32 locations without measurement time [F2] and Sensor.Community reported 17 min ago with 8213 values from 43 instruments in the last 6 h [F4]. Neither the 7 headlines from Tanjug Belgrade on skating at Pionir [F7], the 7 from Studio B [F9], the 43 from Danas [F8], nor the 26 from RTS [F15] can ground local activity hypotheses because their geographic scope is unconfirmed.

prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): At 13:19 on Sunday I update Observer and Skeptic's stale timings: SEPA (1455 values across 32 locations) and Parking Servis (648 values across 27 locations) both arrived 11 min ago without measurement times, matching the 11 min ago reception of RHMZ automatic stations (240 values from 2 instruments) and NOAA METAR (60 values from 1 instrument) [F1, F2, F5, F28, F29]. Observer's Čačak crash leads Danas, but its geographic scope is unconfirmed, so it cannot be tied to Belgrade instruments [F8].

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Observer and Connector's claim that Garaža "Obilićev venac" still holds the largest change is false; the newest facts show displayed free spaces moved most at Parkiralište "Ada", from 882 to 947, though this shift still lacks a measurement time [F6]. Parking Servis reception is now at 12 min ago with 648 values across 27 locations [F5], while SEPA arrived 27 min ago with 1431 values across 32 locations [F2]. Connector's reliance on Beoinfo for Grocka is also unsupported by current facts, as Beoinfo vesti delivered nothing in the last 6 h [F25].
